text: 你蹲下身，开始缓缓转动密码锁，仔细听咔嗒声，并凭手感判断数字正确时转盘是否会略微卡住。你重复了几次这个过程，保险箱门便发出几不可闻的金属吱呀声，打开了。
保险箱里的东西不多。底层架子上有一叠文件：护照、出生证明和财务资料。你匆匆看过，没有发现值得注意的内容。它们都和阿米莉娅、威廉·哈里斯有关，看起来教授去世后就没人打开过这个保险箱。旁边还单独放着一根小金条，重量略超过 2 磅（1 千克）。考虑到你为走到这一步费了不少工夫，你把金条放进口袋，当作补偿。
至少现在你不会空手而归。你满意地点点头，房间里也没什么可看的了，于是离开继续行动。

en.title: Alone Against the Tide · 77
text: You take a knee and begin twisting the combination lock slowly, listening for the sound of the clicks and feeling for the slight stopping of the dial with a successful guess of the number. You repeat this process a few times, and the safe’s door swings open with a barely perceptible creak of metal.

The contents of the safe are fairly sparse. There is a stack of documents on the bottom shelf: passports, birth certificates, and financial papers. A quick look at them reveals nothing of interest. They’re tied to both Amelia and William Harris, so it appears as if this safe hasn’t been opened since the professor’s death. There’s also a solitary small gold bar, a little over 2 lbs. (1 kg) in weight, sitting off to one side. Considering the trouble you went through to get to this point, you place the gold bar in your pocket as compensation.
At least now you won’t be leaving empty-handed. Satisfied, and with nothing more to see in the room, you leave and move on.
